how: Contact sheets of random windows were generated by scripts/review_sheets.py (mask outlined) and scripts/review_unmapped.py (24 random class-6 components) and looked at by the author of this layer on 2026-10-19; counts below are what was seen, not computed.

round_1_before_spectral_gate.seen: Road mask too wide (the outline enclosed grass verge beside roads, 3 to 6 m); false road and 'unmapped' hits on shaded tree crowns and tree shadows (the detector called dark shaded foliage pavement or roof); several real unmapped gravel lanes, a barn and a sand pad were found. Fix: spectral gate (NDVI < 0.12 and saturation < 0.30 on every detector pixel), road pieces kept only if they touch the mapped centre-line core, closing and opening, minimum component 80 px with fill ratio >= 0.25.

round_2_after_gate.seen: Road masks follow the pavement, including roads under partial canopy; building masks follow roofs, include the drive and part of the cast shadow, and sometimes a strip of lawn; subdivision roofs and streets are covered; the power-line mask follows the line; farmyard dirt lanes are masked as road. Residual issues: ragged road edge (1 to 2 m), unmasked concrete aprons and kerbs beside buildings, no mask on gravel lanes that are not near a mapped road.

unmapped_detections_precision.reading: 62 percent confirmed, 75 percent counting the engineered cases; 25 percent false (bare field soil along field edges, a gravel bar in a stream). n = 24, so the binomial 95 percent interval is about 41 to 81 percent confirmed. Class 6 is therefore marked Estimated and listed separately; removing a false hit replaces bare soil with neighbouring field grain, which is harmless, but a true 1863 farm lane may also be removed: the roads layer must restore lanes it can source.
